title: Recover what the method comparison actually compared
statement: Two fresh starts each used A unrestricted competent expert, B demonstrated operations plus strongest ordinary incumbent and missing bridge, or C B plus three different mechanisms/representations. Q42/Q63=A, Q17/Q95=B, Q28/Q54=C. Each had a warm stress/completion round. No accepted original consequential positive in any package; no superior prompt or optimal allocation follows. Six constructions and useful failures are retained in N1035–N1040, with six descriptive RW-method-study-q* records. The earlier planned eighteen fixed-task trials never ran; the amendment preceded trial outputs. Later prior-source exposure and reviewer refinements are separate epochs.

requires: Exact launch inputs, frozen stage1/stage2 outputs and completed masked-label reviews. Opportunity selection was part of treatment; one broad mission family, not six independently matched questions. Requested inherited settings were not immutable served-model/compute receipts.

assumptions: Small observational study; unequal opportunities and unmeasured compute preclude a causal package ranking. Forty/thirty-minute allowances are not measured inference, tokens or compute. Masking was imperfect. Interruptions resumed the same context without reroll. Trial numerical artifacts are synthetic. The post-outcome two known-item retrieval queries are exposed diagnostics, not held out or a general search ranking. No eighteen-trial, Pro-versus-ExtraHigh, worker-allocation or Dots conclusion.
costs: Researcher allowances and extra preparatory/reviewer work are distinct. Actual backend model version, measured tokens, wall/CPU/GPU and cost remain unknown in workflow records. Do not count reviewer replays or sharpenings as additional trial discoveries.
contract.units: Six fresh starts, three packages, two starts per package; warm rounds are continuations, not fresh trials. Time allowances use minutes, not measured compute.
contract.obstruction: Use the retained premises at their stated interfaces. A future matched warm-owner versus fresh compact-handoff comparison is proposed, not executed; it needs the same construction, priors, operations and incumbent.

body: The pretrial amendment replaces the planned eighteen fixed trials with six opportunity-selecting starts. Frozen outputs precede warm completion and later prior exposure. Use ARMS.json and per-Q ASSIGNMENT/CONTINUATION bytes for the initiating treatment; model and usage fields remain null absent receipts. Q28 equality and binary claims match accepted N965/N970; its residual explicit conditional-Umegaki finite formula is retained, with a separately credited later reviewer cutoff. No package reaches the original consequential-positive gate. This preserves mathematical positives and decisive negatives without retroactively changing trial credit.
